scientific_integrity: All volume coefficients reconstructed as sums of exact integer maximal minors; unrestricted parameter statements follow from polynomial identities and a separate algebraic sign proof. Source example, determinant-volume identity, and general Rayleigh context are credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact result only for the displayed six-generator zonotope, fixed test segments, and nonnegative coordinate-box thickening; qualitative phase boundary classified on the two-block slice. No universal zonoid stability theorem or independent historical-priority certification is claimed. Full text of arXiv:2608.12681v1 could not be inspected, and similarly named results may exist.
title: Re-entrant volume log-submodularity under coordinate-box thickening of a four-zonotope
